snippet.title: Dead Ahead: Roadside trailer🚶‍➡️
snippet.description:
𝗗𝗲𝗮𝗱 𝗔𝗵𝗲𝗮𝗱: 𝗥𝗼𝗮𝗱𝘀𝗶𝗱𝗲 is available on Google Play and App Store!
So, what's the game about? 
You’re on foot, walking along the roadside arming a Flipper, beat down baddies and spill their cherry jam (it’s oddly satisfying)💆

The unique pixel art style and cute animations give its special charm: try it out now!
